LanguageData.CC_UI_Sub_Week: What needs you, what's coming, and how people are.
LanguageData.CC_UI_Sub_Everyone: Every colonist in one table: mood, trust, strain, wishes, stories and health.
LanguageData.CC_UI_Sub_Dilemmas: Questions waiting for the council, and how its answers went.
LanguageData.CC_Week_HeaderTip: Everything that wants your attention, in one place. Each line opens its page or goes to the colonist or the place on the map; a click on a card's heading opens the whole page.\n\nPin a colonist or a wish to keep it at the top: the pin shows when you hover a line, a row in Everyone, a wish card or a colonist's page in the roster. A right click on a line offers it too.
LanguageData.CC_Week_ClickPlace: Click to go there on the map.
LanguageData.CC_Week_ClickMap: Click to go to {0} on the map.
LanguageData.CC_Week_ClickMood: Click to select {0} and open their Mood tab.
LanguageData.CC_Week_ClickHealth: Click to select {0} and open their Health tab.
LanguageData.CC_Week_ClickPerson: Click to open {0}'s page in the roster.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Pinned: Pin a colonist or a wish to keep it here.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Wishes: No wishes or petitions are open.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Answers: No letters are waiting for an answer.
LanguageData.CC_Week_LetterDay: {0}: keep the day, or let it pass
LanguageData.CC_Week_News: Colony news letters not yet read: {0}
LanguageData.CC_Week_NewsTip: The evenings' colony news, still on the letter stack. Click to read the newest; "Mark all read" puts them all away.
LanguageData.CC_Week_MarkRead_Tip: Puts every colony news letter away from the letter stack. They stay in the History tab.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Promises: Everything the council granted is where it should be.
LanguageData.CC_Week_TakenBackLeft: taken back, {0} to make it right
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Coming: No days or fights in sight.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Missions: No missions, and no camp on the map.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Strain: Nobody is near a break or worn down.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Health: Nobody is seriously ill or recovering.
LanguageData.CC_Week_Empty_Balance: No colonists to weigh, or the mood insight is switched off.
LanguageData.CC_Week_BalanceTip:
Rimfolk's own moods, added up and shared out per colonist: {0} from the good ones, {1} from the bad ones.

All moods together, from the game, its DLCs, Rimfolk and other mods: {2} good and {3} bad per colonist.

The lines below are the Rimfolk moods that weigh and lift most across the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Week_BalanceLineTip: One of Rimfolk's moods, added up across everyone who has it. The Moods page says why it's there and what to do about it.
LanguageData.CC_Table_HeaderTip: Click a heading to sort by it, and again to sort the other way. Hover a cell to see more. Click a row to select the colonist on the map; right click for their page, their Mood tab and the pin. A mark on the left of a row means it wants attention.
LanguageData.CC_Table_NoneShown: Nobody fits this filter right now.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Filter_Attention_Tip: Colonists in a break or close to one, worn down by strain, about to leave, seriously ill, or with a wish about to run out.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Filter_Pinned_Tip: The colonists pinned to This week.
LanguageData.CC_Table_SortTip: Click to sort by this; again for the other way.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Name_Tip: Their name, with their office and the names they've earned under it.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Mood_Tip: Their mood now, with the minor break line marked on the bar.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Rimfolk_Tip: What Rimfolk's own moods add to theirs, good and bad together.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Trust_Tip: Their trust in the council, and how it moved over the last week.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Strain_Tip: How worn down they are, and the feeling on top of it.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Weighing_Tip: The setbacks and everyday pressures weighing on them, worst first. Hover for what helps with each.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Wish_Tip: Their open wish, and how long it has left.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Story_Tip: Their personal story, and the stage it has reached.
LanguageData.CC_Table_Col_Health_Tip: Everyday ailments, serious illness and convalescence.
LanguageData.CC_Table_ClickMood: Right click for their Mood tab.
LanguageData.CC_Table_RowClick: Click to select them on the map. Right click for their page, their Mood tab and the pin.
LanguageData.CC_Table_NoTrustYet: {0} hasn't made up their mind about the council yet.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Off: Dilemmas are switched off in the mod settings. The answers given before are still here.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_NoneWaiting: No question is waiting for the council.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_TraditionTip: Founded by answering "{0}" the same way, time after time. People now expect it; breaking it upsets them.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_NoHistory: No answers yet. Each one the council gives from now on is kept here, with how it went.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_TipDefault: No answer came in time, so the default happened. An answer nobody gave shapes the colony's ways only half as much.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Went_AsAnswered_Tip: It happened as the answer said.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Went_WentWrong_Tip: The answer was a gamble, and the risk came true.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Went_Waiting_Tip: What the answer set going ({0}) is waiting for its moment: the right hour, people free, no danger about.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Went_UnderWay_Tip: What the answer set going ({0}) is happening right now.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Went_TookPlace_Tip: What the answer set going ({0}) took place, and those who were there have the moods it promised.
LanguageData.CC_Dil_Went_FellThrough_Tip: What the answer set going ({0}) never came about in its time. Everyone it was meant for got its moods anyway.
LanguageData.CC_SetTip_CouncilOpensOn: Which page the council window shows when you open it with its button. A button that leads to a page (a colonist's name, "Go to Wishes") always opens that page.
LanguageData.CC_CouncilOpens_ThisWeek_Tip: Always This week: what needs you, what's coming and how people are.
LanguageData.CC_CouncilOpens_LastPage_Tip: The page you last looked at, also after a restart.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_CouncilOpens_ThisWeek: The council window opens on This week, the page of what needs you.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_CouncilOpens_LastPage: The council window opens where you left it, also after a restart.
